verdicts.rationale: This defect claim misinterprets intentional lenient parsing as a validation gap. Source code confirms Filter.should uses MaybeOneOrMany deserializer (lib/segment/src/common/utils.rs:86-111) which explicitly implements UntaggedEnumVisitor.unit().seq().map() to accept three forms: null/unit, array, and single-object. Test at line 161-167 validates null acceptance. Developer cognition model explicitly documents this as 'Lenient filter parsing... accepted by design... would be a breaking change' to change. Falsification testing shows {should: null} behaves identically to no filter (returns all points). This is graceful handling of null as 'no filter' semantic, not a bug. The defect claim's assumption that 'API should reject null in filter fields' is directly contradicted by source code design and developer documentation.
